evidence: The modified diatom membranes were characterized using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), atomic force microscopy (AFM), energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDAX), and secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS). These techniques confirmed the controlled reduction of pore sizes while preserving the shape of the diatom membrane pores. Nanostructured features of the TiO2 coated diatoms were characterised by XRD, EDAX and SIMS.
